nodes.summary: For $\beta > 0$, the laws of the empirical spectral measure $L_N$ under the Gaussian β-ensemble satisfy, in the space of probability measures on $\mathbb{R}$ with the weak topology, a large deviation principle at speed $N^2$ with the rate function $I_\beta$, and $I_\beta$ is a good rate function (its sublevel sets are compact). Stated here, not proved.
nodes.title: Ben Arous–Guionnet large deviation principle

nodes.summary: For $\beta > 0$ and a probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}$, $I_\beta(\mu) = 0$ if and only if $\mu$ is the semicircle law $\sigma(dx) = \frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{4 - x^2}\,\mathbf{1}_{|x| \le 2}\,dx$. Stated here, not proved. nodes.summary: The unnormalised density \exp\Bigl(-\frac{\beta N}{4} \sum_{i=1}^N \lambda_i^2\Bigr), \qquad \lambda \in \mathbb{R}^N,$$ of the Gaussian β-ensemble, with values in $[0, \infty]$.

nodes.summary: The kernel \quad (x \ne y), \qquad g(x, x) = +\infty,$$ with values in $[0, \infty]$. It is nonnegative: $\frac{x^2 + y^2}{4} \ge \frac{(x - y)^2}{8}$, and $d \mapsto -\log d + d^2/8$ has minimum $\frac{1}{2} - \log 2$ at $d = 2$. It is the kernel $f(x,y) = \log|x-y|^{-1} + \frac{x^2+y^2}{4}$ of Guionnet's proof, shifted to be nonnegative so that its double integral is a well-defined element of $[0, \infty]$ for…
nodes.title: Logarithmic-energy kernel

nodes.summary: For $\lambda \in \mathbb{R}^N$ with $N \ge 1$, the probability measure $L_N = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \delta_{\lambda_i}$ on $\mathbb{R}$, built with the empirical measure of a sample used in Sanov's theorem. For $N = 0$ it is $\delta_0$, a convention that plays no role in asymptotic statements.
nodes.title: Empirical spectral measure

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
